name: player receiving yards per target and per reception differ across a year_offset range (executed-result parity)
description: Seed 2 targets in 2024 (one completion, 10 yards) and 2 in 2025 (one completion, 20 yards), then pool over year=[2023] + year_offset=[1,2]. Per reception is 30/2 = 15; per target is 30/4 = 7.5. Covers the numerator/denominator recombination, which the season fixture is blind to.
expected_query: with "tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812" as materialized (select COALESCE(target_pid) as pid, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN receiving_yards ELSE 0 END) as rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_numerator, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_denominator, SUM(CASE WHEN is_completion = true THEN receiving_yards ELSE 0 END) as rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_numerator, SUM(CASE WHEN target_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_denominator from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) group by COALESCE(target_pid)) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT SUM(tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_numerator) / NULLIF(SUM(tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_denominator), 0) FROM tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812 WHERE tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.pid = player.pid) AS "rec_yds_per_rec_from_plays_0", (SELECT SUM(tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_numerator) / NULLIF(SUM(tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_denominator), 0) FROM tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812 WHERE tbfcf5ec884b1757c002245651e975812.pid = player.pid) AS "rec_yds_per_trg_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
